description: One row of register.jsonl (one SEO finding). register.py loads every allowed value, the field order and the required lists from this file, so the two cannot disagree.

tier.note: 1 blocks crawling or showing of a money page; 2 indexed but cannot rank or convert; 3 slow-burn; 4 cosmetic.

title.note: Plain English. A reworded title never creates a second row.

observed.note: Exact current value. Updated on re-sighting.

age_days.note: today minus first_seen, recomputed on every write and on render; never reset by a re-sighting.

owner.note: One agent name from section 2 of the gap plan.

next_action.note: Required unless status is an end state.

next_action_owner.note: Required unless status is an end state.

next_action_due.note: Required unless status is an end state.

approval.note: Written only by 'register.py approve', once per action. approved_hash is the sha256 of title|target|expected at approval time; sent is refused if it no longer matches. A fix approval is recorded only while the row is waiting_spencer, with a time that is not in the future and not before waiting_since. where must be exactly chat or slack_dm. decision is fix or wont_fix: sent needs fix, wont_fix needs wont_fix, and one never authorizes the other. by must be Spencer; recorded_by must be coordinator; quote_source must be own_message; Cleared (null) on every move into reopened and on every move out of sent or verify_pending except sent to verify_pending and verify_pending to verified_fixed; approve is refused on verified_fixed.

sent.note: When and how the request left. at is the date, sent_at the exact ISO-8601 moment. Required for verified_fixed; reads count only if dated on or after sent.at. Set on every move into sent.

verify.note: Machine rule. type is one of verify_type.

verified.note: passes is a list of {at: ISO-8601 timestamp, passed: true, evidence_path, evidence_sha256, by?}; by is coordinator on reads recorded for a manual rule. verified_fixed needs two passing reads dated on or after sent.sent_at, each with an evidence path, at least 24 hours apart; on a manual rule every read must come from record-manual-check. Cleared on every move into sent, and on a move from sent or verify_pending into reopened or blocked. record-read works only in sent or verify_pending.

sources.note: Report paths that sighted the finding.

surface.note: Where it was seen, for example web, gbp, feed, ai-answer.

target.note: Normalised target (URL: lower-cased path, no query, no fragment, no trailing slash; or a listing ID).

waiting_since.note: Set on each move into waiting_spencer (and when set-expected changes the wording of a waiting row). A fix approval may not be dated earlier than this.

overdue_since.note: Set by flag_overdue on a sent or verify_pending row with no conclusive result 14 days after sent.sent_at. Status and approval are kept; the row appears in asks. Cleared on any move except sent to verify_pending.

verification_rules.note: Each pass stores evidence_path (relative, under the register's evidence/ folder) and evidence_sha256. validate fails a pass whose file is missing or whose hash differs.
